methodologyNotes: 15 power banks a buyer compares in 2026, spanning flagship high-wattage, laptop-capable, mid-tier, and compact segments. Verification (this revision, accessed 2026-06-15): load-bearing specs and US prices for the highest-profile products were re-checked against manufacturer/authoritative sources rather than retailer search-result snippets. Confirmed direct on anker.com: Anker Prime A1340 (27650mAh/250W, $179.99, 665g), Anker Prime A110A (26250mAh/300W, $229.99, 600g, USB-A=22.5W), Anker 737/A1289 (24000mAh/140W, $119.99), Anker Laptop A1695 (25000mAh/165W, $119.99, 3x USB-C 100W + 1x USB-A, smart display). Corrected against UGREEN US / Amazon / Best Buy: both Nexode 25000 models are 2x USB-C + 1x USB-A (the original '3x USB-C' was wrong); 145W MSRP $109.99, 200W TFT MSRP $129.99 (USB-C 140W+100W, USB-A 18W). Corrected against sharge.com / Amazon / Modern of Many: Shargeek Storm 2 Slim is 20000mAh / 130W / 1x USB-C (100W) + 1x USB-A (30W) / $169 / IPS screen — the prior 24000mAh/140W/2x USB-C/$222 entry conflated it with the 'Shargeek 170' search listing. Baseus Blade (Blade H1/HD, A1289-class retail SKUs aside) confirmed 20000mAh/100W/2x USB-C+2x USB-A with a digital display. priceUsd is US MSRP for the base config; null where unconfirmable. Mophie Powerstation Pro 20K (PS-2025-20K, $39.99) wattage/ports left null — neither mophie.com nor Apple surfaced the spec and no authoritative secondary confirmed it. Remaining mid/compact entries (INIU B61, Baseus Bipow Pro, Anker Nano A1638/A1653, Anker MagGo A1664, Belkin BoostCharge Pro 20K) retain retailer-derived specs and are lower-confidence. Weight in oz converted from grams (1 oz = 28.35 g); many weights null because no source surfaced them. accessedAt=2026-06-15 throughout.
